name: Pulmonary Valve Agenesis-Tetralogy of Fallot-Absence of Ductus Arteriosus Syndrome
aliases: Pulmonary Valve Agenesis with Tetralogy of Fallot and Absent Ductus Arteriosus

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Imaging Diagnostic Criteria for Pulmonary Valve Agenesis-TOF-Absence of Ductus Arteriosus Syndrome

criteria.description: Congenital absence or agenesis of the pulmonary valve confirmed by echocardiography or cardiac MRI
Presence of Tetralogy of Fallot anatomical features: ventricular septal defect, overriding aorta, right ventricular hypertrophy, and pulmonary stenosis
Absence of ductus arteriosus demonstrated by imaging or angiography
Clinical evidence of central cyanosis in neonatal period
Right ventricular dilation and pulmonary artery dilation on imaging

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of pulmonary valve agenesis, Tetralogy of Fallot features, and absence of ductus arteriosus confirmed by imaging
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis relies heavily on echocardiographic and angiographic findings in neonates presenting with cyanosis and heart murmur.

searchTerms: baby with low oxygen skin color

pathognomonic.symptomName: Systolic ejection murmur due to pulmonary outflow obstruction
pathognomonic.notes: Harsh murmur heard best at upper left sternal border
searchTerms: heart murmur during heartbeat from lung artery blockage
systolic murmur from pulmonary valve narrowing
heart sound from blood flow obstruction to lungs

pathognomonic.symptomName: Absent or severely hypoplastic pulmonary valve leaflets
searchTerms: missing or very small lung valve flaps
absent or underdeveloped pulmonary valve parts

common.symptomName: Dyspnea on exertion or feeding difficulties in neonates
common.notes: Due to compromised pulmonary blood flow
searchTerms: shortness of breath with activity or feeding in newborns
difficulty breathing or feeding in infants
breathlessness during exercise or feeding in babies

common.notes: Secondary to chronic hypoxia and cardiac insufficiency
Develops over time with chronic hypoxemia

common.symptomName: Pulmonary regurgitation with dilated pulmonary arteries
searchTerms: leaking lung valve with enlarged lung arteries
pulmonary valve backflow with artery widening
blood flowing backward through lung valve with artery dilation

occasional.notes: May occur due to right ventricular dilation
Due to airway compression from dilated pulmonary arteries
Compensatory increase in red blood cells

rare.notes: Due to rupture of dilated pulmonary arteries
Paradoxical embolism through ventricular septal defect

searchTerms: heart failure with swelling in limbs
fluid buildup causing leg swelling from heart problems
peripheral edema due to heart weakness

rare.symptomName: Seizures secondary to hypoxic brain injury
searchTerms: seizures caused by brain oxygen loss
convulsions after brain injury from low oxygen
epileptic episodes due to hypoxic brain damage

laboratory: Elevated hematocrit due to secondary polycythemia
imaging: Echocardiography demonstrating absent pulmonary valve leaflets and Tetralogy of Fallot features
Cardiac MRI confirming right ventricular hypertrophy and absence of ductus arteriosus
Chest X-ray showing enlarged pulmonary arteries and right heart enlargement
genetic: No specific genetic mutation identified; sporadic occurrence
Genetic testing may be performed to exclude syndromic associations
other: Electrocardiogram showing right ventricular hypertrophy and possible arrhythmias
Cardiac catheterization confirming absence of ductus arteriosus

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of pulmonary valve but with stenosis rather than agenesis
Absent pulmonary valve with associated ductus arteriosus usually present
Severe bronchial compression due to dilated pulmonary arteries
May lack classic Tetralogy of Fallot features

redFlags: Severe neonatal cyanosis unresponsive to oxygen therapy
Progressive respiratory distress due to airway compression
Signs of congestive heart failure in early infancy
references: Garg V. Tetralogy of Fallot and related congenital heart defects: molecular genetics and pathogenesis. Pediatr Cardiol. 2020.
